verdict.rationale: Cal.com's own materials claim a 'generous free tier' and describe sharing a booking link that lets people pick a time. A hands-on user confirms the free plan works well enough to run their recruiter booking calendar without paying. However, that same user reports the free tier dropped to just 1 active event type after the trial ended, a significant caveat for 'real individual scheduling'. Missing for 10: first-party documentation of exactly what the free plan includes (event-type limits, calendar connections, booking-link features), and independent confirmation that the free tier is not capped at a single active event type.
